subject: AWS Marketplace: metering & entitlement handover for Datasync (SaaS contract + billing)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@datasync.ai>

Date: 2027-04-29T16:12:00Z
Subject: AWS Marketplace metering question — Datasync SaaS offering

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for taking time today. As discussed, we're finalizing our SaaS contract and need to map how our product features translate into AWS Marketplace metered dimensions. High-level asks:

- Confirm recommended approach for single-subscription entitlements vs per-feature entitlements.
- Best practice for usage-dimension naming (avoid renames later).
- Reconciliation cadence and how refunds/chargebacks are handled if meters under-report during a rollout.

We're aiming for a May 10th go/no-go for marketplace listing. Can we schedule a 30-min technical handover with your billing/instrumentation lead?

I've attached the product metric export for the last quarter — it contains the candidate meters we think map to AWS dimensions.

Thanks,
Alicia
Product Lead, Datasync.ai
attachment: product-metric-mapping.csv (CSV)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@datasync.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-29T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering question — Datasync SaaS offering

Hi Alicia — great to meet earlier. Looping in Ben (Marketplace PM) and Karthik (Billing eng) so we can align on entitlement model and implementation cadence.

Initial thoughts (high level):
- Entitlement model: prefer a "single subscription + optional feature dimensions" pattern for your use case. It gives clean contract boundaries while allowing usage meters to bill incremental features.
- Naming: use stable canonical names (company_product.feature_name.v1) and avoid embedding dates or environment names. We can maintain a mapping table in the listing metadata.
- Reconciliation: we recommend daily aggregation with weekly reconciliation window for the first 90 days to catch edge cases. For refunds, AWS Marketplace supports adjustments via usage records before invoice finalization — we should plan for a reconciliation job to surface anomalies and an ops playbook for manual adjustments.

Karthik — can you review the attached AWS listing requirements matrix and the product-metric file Alicia sent? I've attached the Redwood checklist we use for ingestion.

Next steps:
1) Karthik to propose meter->dimension mapping. (owner: Karthik)
2) Ben to initiate AWS Marketplace seller integration ticket and share required listing artifacts. (owner: Ben)
3) Alicia to confirm contract clause for entitlement activation (trial vs paid activation). (owner: Datasync)

Proposed 30-min tech handover: Tue 2027-05-04 15:00 PT — does that work for everyone?

attachment: aws_listing_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)

—Olga
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>

Date: 2027-04-30T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering question — Datasync SaaS offering

Thanks — quick pass from the Marketplace side with concrete mapping suggestions. Quoting Olga's notes below and adding proposed dimensions.

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 11:03, Olga Petrov wrote:
> Initial thoughts (high level):
> - Entitlement model: prefer a "single subscription + optional feature dimensions" pattern for your use case.

Proposed metric -> AWS dimension mapping (draft):
- active_users_monthly -> dimension: active_user_hours (unit: hours) — aggregated hourly, sent as usage records
- sync_jobs_successful -> dimension: sync_jobs (unit: count) — we recommend a single cumulative counter per day
- storage_gb_avg -> dimension: storage_gb (unit: gigabyte) — report daily average for billing accuracy
- premium_api_calls -> dimension: premium_api_calls (unit: count) — separate overage dimension behind feature entitlement

Implementation notes:
- Use marketplace usage records API with idempotency token to avoid duplicate billing.
- Mirror your internal feature entitlement IDs to the AWS entitlement metadata so we can support automatic entitlement activation.
- For trials: create an entitlement activation event upon contract signature; usage before activation should be recorded to a sandbox dimension (not billed).

Risk & mitigation:
- Under-reporting during rollout: implement a quick parallel runner that diffs internal counters vs submitted records for the first 7 days. Owner: Karthik.
- Naming drift: keep canonical mapping in a version-controlled csv (we've attached product-metric-mapping.csv).

I'll open the seller ticket with AWS Marketplace ops after Alicia confirms the mapping and SOW.

—Ben
Marketplace PM, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben, this mapping looks good overall — appreciate the concrete dimension names. A few clarifications from legal/finance side:

- Contract / SOW: our legal team requires an activation clause that ties entitlement activation to our signature in DocuSign; usage prior to the activation date must be explicitly excluded from billing. I've attached the draft SOW with the activation language highlighted.
- Invoicing cadence: we prefer monthly invoices with usage reconciled on invoice finalization; please confirm if AWS auto-billing supports our preferred adjustment window.
- Marketplace listing artifacts: we'll deliver marketing assets by May 6 once the listing metadata is locked.

DocuSign (draft SOW): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234-datasync-sow

Looking forward to the 5/4 handover.

—Alicia
